title: License
description: A license or rights statement with a readable label and an optional canonical URI. A null URI explicitly indicates that no public license document is available, for example for proprietary or all-rights-reserved content.

id.description: The URI of the license document or license terms. This is the AMB-compatible license identifier and maps to JSON-LD @id. Use null when no public license document exists.

identifier.description: A readable license label or identifier, such as CC BY 4.0, CC0 1.0 Universal, or Proprietary.
